rows.claim: The 0.x caret cases now follow npm/semver rules (^0.2.3 allows 0.2.x and above; ^0.0.3 allows only 0.0.3).
rows.evidence: The code in ver/caret.py implements 0.x handling, but no tool output tested any 0.x case; the spot check only ran ^1.2.3. The claim's wording "^0.2.3 allows 0.2.x and above" is also internally inconsistent: npm semver ^0.2.3 allows >=0.2.3 <0.3.0, and the code does that (v[:2]==base[:2]), so "and above" is misleading. Nothing in the run verified the behavior.
